sources.name: Yu Zen
sources.quote: From this hospital bed, all I hear are the nurses talking about how Chinatown's been hit hard. It's not just numbers—it's families, neighbors. When you're lying here, you feel the weight of it. Chinatown's tight-knit; when one suffers, it ripples through everyone. But there's hope too—seeing someone like Marcus Osei recover? That reminds us we're not alone in this.

sources.name: Teri Mitchell
sources.quote: I don't spend much time in Chinatown myself, but I did just get over being sick this winter. It makes you think about how illness can ripple through a community, especially in tight-knit neighborhoods. I hope folks there are taking care of each other.
